title: [LOGGED IN] Loyalty Shop shows a "not enough points" message for an item that costs too much
reason: Clicking 1100 on Astral hero with balance 200 showed 'Not enough loyalty points. Earn more by making purchases.' (server POST returned 422); balance stayed 200, card still 1/1

steps.text: Start a new browser session with no saved cookies. Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/?user-id=12580628 in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded; URL became https://site.ludus-game.com/store/; cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If any other popup is shown after login, close it. Do not click the "Player12580628" button: it logs out.
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss on the cookie banner; no 'Login successful' popup was shown

steps.text: Does the header show a green "Player12580628" button and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Header shows green 'Player12580628' button (gradient rgb(12,150,87)->rgb(118,211,71)), balances 200 teal / 0 gold; no visible Login button
Clicked header button 'Loyalty shop'; page scrolled to the Loyalty Shop section

steps.text: Is the teal loyalty points balance in the header lower than 1100? (precondition)
steps.saw: Teal loyalty balance in header = 200, which is lower than 1100

steps.text: Write down the teal loyalty points balance shown in the header. Is it a number?
Does the "Astral hero" card show "Available weekly: 1/1" and a "1100" button?
steps.saw: Astral hero card (x2 hero card): 'Available weekly: 1/1' and green button '1100' with teal loyalty icon

steps.text: Click the "1100" button on the "Astral hero" card. If a confirmation popup is shown, do not confirm: only read it.
steps.saw: Clicked '1100' once. No confirmation popup appeared; the site sent POST .../payment/item/LoyaltyShopSlotVolkov/loyalty_point/... which returned 422, and an error toast appeared at the top

steps.text: Is a message shown saying there are not enough points (or the purchase is not possible)?
steps.saw: Toast at top of page: 'Not enough loyalty points. Earn more by making purchases.' with a red ! icon and a Close (x) button

steps.text: Close the message or popup with its close (x) button.
steps.saw: Clicked the toast's 'Close' (x) button; toast disappeared (0 visible elements with the message)

steps.text: Is the teal loyalty points balance in the header the same as before?
steps.saw: Teal loyalty balance still 200 (before: 200); gold store points still 0

steps.text: Does the "Astral hero" card still show "Available weekly: 1/1"?
steps.saw: Astral hero card still shows 'Available weekly: 1/1' and button '1100'
